items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Stiles was the bass player when I first came in.

ctx.x: Oh, no. New Paltz? Not New Brunswick? What's upstate? [Binghamton?]

Well, as I was saying, it's near Syracuse. So, he came down and played piano with me over the weekends until I got Joe Fatali. And, he was very good. He's gonna be a doctor, too, and take his music. And Doug Richards, he took Jimmy Stiles' place. Jimmy Stiles was the bass player when I first came in. He's back in New York. He was up here for about 12 years. Jimmy Stiles was. Doug's been with me now two or a little better. A good bass player. And, I think that's the group that I have now. They're all very nice…

call them up. I'll say yeah, I'll make the 5:00. You know, if I got a 5:00 in the lounge? I just tell them. They say yeah, I'll make it. I'll see you on the next set. They're right there to do the job. [Phone Interruption]
